# Dist CSS and Font Awesome roots die on absolute mounts — substring(6) is relative-only

## Context

The defect is real and engine-wide: the absolute-mount config shape is legal per the D#17886 contract cells, and the current derivation black-pages it. What this ticket is NOT anymore: a deployment blocker. The consumer workspace that originally hit it has conformed to the canonical position-relative shape (verified on vanilla `dev`: source + both webpack dist environments + SharedWorker session join), so no live deployment depends on this fix.

**Implementation is gated, not scheduled:** PR #17919 delivered a complete candidate implementation and was closed Drop+Supersede (implementation-before-authority — D#17886's path contract has open gates 5/6/8 and #17884 is `[PROVISIONAL_UNGRADUATED]`). The salvage is pinned: branch `vega/17918-dist-absolute-roots` @ `b5d1ed4b4c` carries `getAbsoluteDistRoot()`/`getCssRoot()`/`getFontAwesomePath()`, the eight derivation/settlement spec arms, and the Font Awesome mutation witness. When D#17886 graduates and #17884 authorizes, that slice is the starting point — under whatever contract shape graduation lands, which may subsume rather than adopt it.

## The Problem

`src/main/addon/Stylesheet.mjs` derives every dist CSS/resource root as `basePath.substring(6)` at three sites (`:55` Font Awesome non-dev branch, `:78` `addGlobalCss`, `:105` `addThemeFiles`). The formula means "strip one `../../` hop" — correct only for the engine's own relative serving, where the page lives inside `dist/<env>/apps/<app>/` and basePath is a relative climb. An absolute mount (`basePath: '/<mount>/'`, one index per app OUTSIDE dist — a fixed-mount server arrangement) becomes `udio/…`: every sheet 404s and the mount never completes.

## The Architectural Reality

The relative invariant: `rootPath` addresses "two levels above the page", and the css tree hangs at `<root>/dist/<env>/css` (dist-mode pages already sit inside `dist/<env>`, making `rootPath` BE the dist root). The absolute-mount equivalent is direct: `basePath + (env.startsWith('dist/') ? env : 'dist/' + env) + '/'`. Same target for the Font Awesome resources branch (`resources/fontawesome-free/**` is copied into each dist tree — verified in the D#17886 matrix).

## The Fix

One private helper on the addon returning the absolute dist root when `basePath` is absolute (`/`-prefixed or fully qualified), `null` otherwise; the three sites use it and keep their existing relative arithmetic byte-identical when it returns `null`. No config surface changes; no behavior change for any of the 158 relative-basePath configs.

Decision Record impact: aligned-with #17884/D#17886 (interim repair the converged contract later subsumes; the fixture's mount-escape red control is the acceptance instrument).

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dist CSS root derivation (`addGlobalCss`, `addThemeFiles`) | `src/main/addon/Stylesheet.mjs#getCssRoot` (folds `getAbsoluteDistRoot`) | absolute/fully-qualified `basePath` → `basePath + dist/<env>/`; relative basePath → the pre-existing strip-one-hop arithmetic, byte-identical | none — pure derivation, no config surface added | helper JSDoc names both serving shapes | per-site exact-URL spec arms; relative shapes pinned; reverted derivation reds every absolute arm |
| Font Awesome path (bundled envs) | `Stylesheet#getFontAwesomePath` | same dist-root derivation for the copied `resources/fontawesome-free` tree; source/`dist/esm` stay package-rooted (`basePath + node_modules/…`, absolute-safe already) | none | helper JSDoc | dedicated spec arm across all four shapes; FA-site mutation reds it (measured) |

Retirement: the #17884/D#17886 contract (one normalized root, per-surface matrix) subsumes both rows; these helpers become its first migration targets.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: with `basePath: '/mount/'` and `environment: 'dist/<env>'`, all three sites emit `/mount/dist/<env>/…` URLs (unit spec per site, driving the real methods with a stubbed document).
- [ ] AC-2: red control — the pre-fix derivation (`substring(6)`) on an absolute basePath is asserted broken by the same spec shape (mutation reds).
- [ ] AC-3: relative-basePath emissions are byte-identical pre/post (spec pins the engine's own shapes: source, deeper app, dist-mode page).
- [ ] AC-4: full unit suite green, fully-parallel.

## Out of Scope

The #17884/D#17886 contract itself (root authority, normalize-once, per-surface matrix); the two `dist/esm` generator defects from the fixture (separate filing); any workspace-side change.

## Related

#17884 (umbrella), D#17886 (fixture + contract), #17894 (the Stylesheet reject-reason repair that added `main/addon/Stylesheet.spec.mjs`, which these arms extend).
